research.text: I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of Statistical Science at Duke University. My research focuses on statistical and computational methods for rigorous and efficient inference, with a focus on the adaptive nature of modeling and analysis in modern data science. I am particularly interested in sampling algorithms with applications to Bayesian inference, selective inference, and generative modeling.
